sentences.en: We are suffering from a severe water shortage this summer.
sentences.zh: 这个夏天我们正遭受严重的水资源短缺。

sentences.en: That is why so many people are suffering from famine.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这么多人正在遭受饥荒的原因。

sentences.en: Can we find joy in spite of suffering and death?
sentences.zh: 我们能在苦难和死亡中找到快乐吗？
